night.meaning: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet. Before anything began, Jesus was there.
God is alive. He hears, He sees, and He acts.
Adonai means Lord and Master, the One we follow.

bibleNote.kjv: In the King James Bible, LORD in capital letters is Yahweh. "Lord" is Adonai.

night.meaning: There is one God, and He is not divided.
Elohim is the first name for God in the Bible. It tells of His power as Maker of everything.
Immutable means unchanging. God does not shift like a shadow.
El means God. Shaddai means Almighty: nothing is too hard for Him.
Infinite means without limit. No one can measure how great God is.
Olam means forever. God has no beginning and no end, and He never wears out.
God is true, and everything He says can be trusted.
Elyon means highest. No one and nothing is above Him.
God keeps His word. His mercy is new every morning.
Qodash means holy: set apart, with no wrong in Him at all.
Eternal means without beginning or end. God has always been, and He always will be.
Qanno means jealous, though not in a petty way. God cares too much to leave us to what harms us.
God is spirit. He is not held in one place or seen with our eyes.
Israel is the new name God gave Jacob. God ties His own name to people and keeps His promises to them.
Omnipresent means everywhere at once. There is nowhere God is not.
Hagar gave God this name when He found her alone in the desert. He sees each person.
Omniscient means all-knowing. Nothing is hidden from God.
Gadol means great. Nora means awesome: so great it fills us with wonder.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible says "terrible," an old word for awesome.

night.meaning: Omnipotent means all-powerful. God has the strength to do all He plans.
Chanun means gracious. He gives kindness and mercy we have not earned.
God always knows what is best, and how to bring it about.
Neeman means faithful. He keeps every promise He makes.

night.meaning: Holy means set apart. God is pure and good in a way nothing else is.
Chai means living. God is alive, and He is at work today.
God is fair. He does what is right, and He makes things right.
Sabaoth means armies or hosts: the countless stars and angels. All of them answer to Him.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible says "hosts," an old word for armies.

night.meaning: God is good, and what He does is good.
Yahweh is God's own name. It comes from the words "I AM": He always was, He is, and He always will be.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters. Jehovah is an older spelling of the same name.

night.meaning: God is love. Love is not only what He does. It is who He is.
Jireh means He sees, and He sees to it. God sees what is needed and provides.
God gives good gifts to people who have not earned them.
Rapha means to heal or mend. Body, heart, and soul are all in His care.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters.

night.meaning: God does not treat us as our wrongs deserve. He stays with us.
A banner is a flag lifted high so people can find their way to it. He is the One we gather around.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters.

night.meaning: God is slow to anger. He gives people time to turn around.
Sanctify means to make holy. It is His work in us, not something we earn.
Sovereign means ruling over all. Nothing is outside God's care and command.
Rohi means my shepherd. He leads, feeds, and guards those in His care.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters.

night.meaning: Immense means too great to be held in. The whole sky cannot contain God.
Tsidkenu means our righteousness. Being right with God is His gift, not our doing.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters.

night.meaning: There is no evil in God at all.
Shalom means peace: not just quiet, but everything made whole.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters.

night.meaning: God hates what destroys people: pride, lies, violence, and stirring up fights.
Shammah means He is there. Wherever we go, God is already there.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible writes Yahweh as LORD, in capital letters.

night.meaning: Blessed here means happy. God is full of joy, and He is where joy comes from.
Immanuel means God with us. In Jesus, God came to live among us.

bibleNote.kjv: The King James Bible spells it Emmanuel.

night.meaning: Immortal means He cannot die. God's life has no end.

night.meaning: The name Jesus means the Lord saves. His name says what He came to do.
We cannot see God with our eyes. Faith is trusting the One we cannot see.
Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet. When everything ends, Jesus will still be there.
